message.reasoning_content:
We need to list crimes based on the fact: On July 16, 2015, Xie 1 broke into Wen's house, kicked open the door, committed theft, stole over 2500 yuan cash, then fled.

So crime: theft (盗窃罪). Also possibly "非法侵入住宅罪"? In Chinese criminal law, breaking into a dwelling to commit theft is still theft; there is also "入室盗窃罪" which is a specific form of theft. The statutory name is "盗窃罪". Could also be "抢劫罪"? No, no violence to obtain property, just forced entry. Kicking door is not violence against person, just property. So theft.

Thus answer: [盗窃罪]<eoa>. Use format: [罪名]盗窃罪<eoa>.
